title: 生物安保的关键方面
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/16_Key aspects of biosecurity, biosecurity microbiology laboratory raqbamicrohub.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/16_Key aspects of biosecurity, biosecurity microbiology laboratory raqbamicrohub/src.py

points.K4: 同一健康：人和动物连在一起

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼前，身边浮现六块拼图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a lab building with six puzzle pieces floating around it, each with a simple icon.
shots.narration: 欢迎回到生物安全课。

shots.scene: 六块拼图拼成一面盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The six puzzle pieces snap together to form a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 今天讲生物安保的六个关键方面。

shots.scene: 小组讨论室里，阿杰对着空白海报发愁
shots.prompt_en: In a small meeting room, the young male student frowns at a blank poster board with a marker in hand.
shots.narration: 阿杰要给新生做一张生物安保海报。

shots.scene: 阿杰在纸上只写了一把锁的图案
shots.prompt_en: The young male student has drawn only a padlock on the blank poster and looks unsure.
shots.narration: 他只想到一个字：锁。

shots.scene: 小研拿来六张空白卡片，摊在桌上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student spreads six blank cards with different icons across the table.
shots.narration: 小研说：锁只是其中一块，一共六块。

shots.scene: 牛、麦穗、人三个图标之间的箭头被打断
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a cow, a wheat stalk and a person, with the arrows between them cut by red breaks. No people.
shots.narration: 第一块，防止疾病传播。

shots.scene: 消毒脚垫、洗手池、隔离栏三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a disinfectant foot mat, a hand-washing sink, and a separation fence. No people.
shots.narration: 定好规程，切断传播的路，

shots.scene: 动物房门口，老李在消毒脚垫上换鞋
shots.prompt_en: At the animal facility entrance, the facility engineer changes into facility shoes beside a disinfectant foot mat.
shots.narration: 让病不在人和动植物之间传来传去。

shots.scene: 实验楼、养殖场、运输车三个图标，各被一个罩子罩住
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a lab building, a farm barn and a transport van, each covered by a transparent dome. No people.
shots.narration: 第二块，封闭与控制。

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜里操作，柜门半开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works inside a biological safety cabinet with gloves and a lab coat.
shots.narration: 实验室里，靠设施和规范把它关住，

shots.scene: 密封样品箱被放进专用运输箱
shots.prompt_en: A sealed sample box with a biohazard sign is placed inside a sturdy transport container. No people.
shots.narration: 农场和运输系统，也要封闭控制。

shots.scene: 雷达屏幕上出现一个小亮点
shots.prompt_en: A radar-style screen with a single small blip lighting up. No people.
shots.narration: 第三块，监测。

shots.scene: 日历和折线图，曲线出现一个小高峰
shots.prompt_en: A calendar beside a line chart where one small peak appears. No people.
shots.narration: 定期查看有没有疫病或异常的迹象，

shots.scene: 小火苗被及时扑灭的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small flame being put out early before it spreads. No people.
shots.narration: 发现得早，处理就快。

shots.section_title: 同一健康：人和动物连在一起
shots.scene: 人、动物、环境三个圆圈相交
shots.prompt_en: Three overlapping circles with icons of a person, an animal and a tree; the overlap glows. No people.
shots.narration: 这里有个重要观念：同一健康。
overlay: 同一健康：人和动物连在一起

shots.section_title: 同一健康：人和动物连在一起
shots.scene: 蝙蝠、家禽、家畜图标和人图标之间有虚线箭头
shots.prompt_en: Dashed arrows connect icons of wild animals, poultry and livestock to a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不少传染病来自动物，

shots.section_title: 同一健康：人和动物连在一起
shots.scene: 基因测序仪、监测地图、计算机模型三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a gene sequencer, a monitoring map with pins, and a computer with a model chart. No people.
shots.narration: 要靠检测、监测和模型一起盯着，

shots.section_title: 同一健康：人和动物连在一起
shots.scene: 三圈中心的人形图标发亮
shots.prompt_en: A person icon at the center of the three circles, glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 还要始终关注人本身。

shots.scene: 一本空白法律书和一个天平
shots.prompt_en: A blank law book next to a balance scale icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第四块，法规与合规。

shots.scene: 农田、医院、实验室三个图标下各有一本空白手册
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a farm, a hospital and a research lab, each with a blank rule book below. No people.
shots.narration: 农业、医疗、科研，都要守规定。

shots.scene: 王老师给学生讲解，白板上是三本书的图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains to students in front of a whiteboard showing three book icons.
shots.narration: 依照法律法规来执行，

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白培训签到表上签名
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank training attendance sheet.
shots.narration: 确保各领域都落实生物安保措施。

shots.scene: 大喇叭和一群人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A loudspeaker icon facing a crowd of person outlines. No people.
shots.narration: 第五块，公众意识与教育。

shots.scene: 阿杰在社区科普展板前给居民讲解
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at a community science booth with a blank poster, talking to a few residents.
shots.narration: 让大家知道风险在哪，

shots.scene: 居民们看着展板点头
shots.prompt_en: Residents nod as they look at the blank poster with simple icons. No people shown in detail.
shots.narration: 也了解该怎么做。

shots.scene: 一本空白应急预案和一个闹钟
shots.prompt_en: A blank emergency plan binder next to an alarm clock. No people.
shots.narration: 第六块，应急准备与响应。

shots.scene: 疫情地图和红色警示三角两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an outbreak map with red dots and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 包括疫情暴发和生物恐怖事件，

shots.scene: 老周和王老师对着空白预案开会
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator review a blank emergency plan at a meeting table.
shots.narration: 要提前写好预案，定期更新，

shots.scene: 王老师组织学生演练，阿杰拿起电话报告
shots.prompt_en: During a drill organised by the safety administrator, the young male student picks up a phone to report.
shots.narration: 让应对计划随时可用。

shots.scene: 一个圆形图分六格：水、饲料、空气、技术、设计、人
shots.prompt_en: A round chart divided into six segments with icons: water drops, a feed bag, wind, a gear, a barn blueprint, and a person. No people.
shots.narration: 再看养殖场风险管理的例子。

shots.scene: 水、饲料、空气三格依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The water, feed and air segments of the chart light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 水、饲料、空气，都可能带进病原；

shots.scene: 设计、技术、人三格依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The design, technology and person segments of the chart light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 布局、技术和人的习惯，决定能否挡住。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁六块拼图依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside six puzzle pieces lighting up one by one.
shots.narration: 防传播、封闭控制、监测，

shots.scene: 后三块拼图亮起，合成盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The last three puzzle pieces light up and the six pieces form a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 依法管理、公众教育、应急响应。

shots.scene: 阿杰的海报上画满六个图标，小研竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's poster is now filled with six icons; the female graduate student gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 六块拼齐，生物安保才牢靠。

shots.scene: 欣欣、阿杰、小研站在海报前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye in front of the finished poster.
shots.narration: 六块拼齐，下次见！
